subject: Concordance MAP — staircase commit offer & checkpoint QA
messages:
From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@concordance.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP draft + evaluation checkpoints

Hi Michael / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Concordance is excited by the latency profile and the KV caching behavior you showed. Attached is our updated MAP (Concordance_MAP_v3.pdf) with proposed checkpoints and a suggested commit profile. A couple of asks as we get towards commercial: 

- Can you confirm the unit economics if we tie a 3-quarter staircase commit (Q3–Q4–Q1) with ramp credits at each checkpoint?
- We need clarity on the acceptance criteria for each checkpoint (what we validate during the eval window).
- Any possibility to shift more of the initial ramp to a usage-credit model vs a hard pre-commit?

We'd like to get this agreed to by the end of the month so internal procurement can start SOW review.

Attachments: Concordance_MAP_v3.pdf

—Jamie
Jamie Liu
Head of AI Infrastructure, Concordance AI
jamie.liu@concordance.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@concordance.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP draft + evaluation checkpoints

Jamie — thanks for the MAP and clear asks. High level response below; I'll attach a concise pricing slidebook (pricing_slides_v5.pptx) with worked examples.

Summary proposal (starter):
- Stairs: 3 tranches across quarters (commit volumes: 250k / 500k / 1M tokens)
- Ramp credits: 25% credit on tranche 1, 15% on tranche 2, 5% on tranche 3 (applied as API credits over the first 30/60/90 days after tranche start)
- Acceptance: a two-week eval window per tranche with pre-agreed prompt set and latency targets (SLO: p95 < 180ms)
- Trial bucket: we can carve a 100k trial bucket that is refundable/creditable against tranche 1 if acceptance metrics are met

Open items where we need your stance:
1) Do you want credits applied as token rebate or invoice-level discount?
2) For legal/procurement — will Concordance accept a MAP appendix + SOW (Redwood standard terms) or require master SLA edits?

Next steps: Marissa will surface the approval path for any extra commercial concessions (e.g., deeper upfront credit) and Ben will model net economics once we confirm the credit mechanic. I'm happy to hop on a 30-min call Thursday to go line-by-line.

Attachments: pricing_slides_v5.pptx

Regards,
Michael Grant
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@concordance.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP draft + evaluation checkpoints

Looping in commercial math and legal path. Internal notes below (Ben / Jordan — please action):

- Alternative discount cadence proposal: Convert tranche credits to a timeboxed usage rebate that steps down 30% → 20% → 10% to simplify invoicing. That is slightly more aggressive than Michael's starter but helps Concordance with cashflow while limiting Redwood downside.
- Approval gating: Any >25% net concession requires Director-level signoff (Marissa) + finance alignment. Anything >35% needs VP approval.
- Redlines: Legal will expect a MAP appendix plus SOW; Concordance redlines should be consolidated and sent back as a single document.

Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- Checkpoint 1: run 7-day eval on representative workload (3 prompt families), pass accuracy/regression checks and p95 latency < 180ms
- Checkpoint 2: run 14-day eval on expanded prompt set, throughput smoke test, integration gating
- Checkpoint 3: production onramp validation (obs for 30 days)

I'll attach redlines_concordance.docx with our comments. Ben — please produce a net ARR model by Monday so we can see the effective blended price under both credit constructs.

Attachments: redlines_concordance.docx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@concordance.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rajesh Patel <rajesh@concordance.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP draft + evaluation checkpoints

Thanks — the rebate-as-usage-credit approach is preferred (easier for our accounting). A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- For the refundable trial bucket: is there a maximum time window after which the trial is non-refundable even if we don't convert?
- Acceptance tests: can you commit to providing a dedicated RedTeam contact for triage during the 7/14-day windows? That will reduce friction on our side.

Procurement note: our legal would prefer to see a MAP appendix + SOW; they will only ask for SLA edits if we hit a commercial hang-up. We'll consolidate internal redlines and aim to send them over by next Wednesday.

Looking forward to the Monday ARR model. If we can get a DocuSign-ready MAP + SOW next week, we can aim for signature by the end of June.

—Jamie
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@concordance.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Updated MAP draft + evaluation checkpoints

Jamie — appreciate the clarity. Final alignment and next steps: 

- Trial bucket: 100k tokens refundable for 30 days; if Concordance does not initiate tranche 1 within 60 days of trial completion, the bucket converts to a 50% credit applied to first invoice (protects Redwood from open churn).
- Rebate mechanics: usage-credit model (applied at invoice line as token credit). Ben will include both rebate and invoice-discount scenarios in his model so you can compare.
- Redwood support: we will assign a RedTeam lead for checkpoint triage (Jordan will be primary) and agree SLA response windows during the eval windows.
- Legal/DocuSign: Marissa will consolidate and we will ship a DocuSign-ready package (MAP appendix + SOW) once we receive your consolidated redlines.

Action items: 
- Ben Carter: ARR/net price model (rebate vs discount) — due Monday 2027-05-24
- Marissa Cole: finalize approval memo and prepare DocuSign packet after redlines come in
- Jamie/Concordance: send consolidated redlines and confirm trial kickoff window by EOW May 28

If those timelines hold we'll plan a targeted signature by June 30. I'll elevate a small one-time concession (additional 5% credit on tranche 1) for Director approval to help close — Marissa, please confirm if you can approve that within the thresholds above.
